crossRefs.note: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom. Of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel. Of the sons of David, Hattush.

people.name: Bariah
people.line: A descendant of David through the line of Solomon.

people.name: Hattush
people.line: A descendant of King Jeconiah (Jehoiachin) of Judah.

people.name: Neariah
people.line: Descendant of David, son of Shemaiah.

people.name: Shaphat
people.line: Descendant of David during the postexilic period

translations.web: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
translations.bsb: The six descendants of Shecaniah were Shemaiah and his sons: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
translations.asv: And the sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. And the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Igal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
